author: pereanub
title: LLM accuracy iGPU tests fail uploading test results - artifact blob storage returns HTML error page
signature: artifact upload to blob storage failed html error page returned during finalizeartifact|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Test suite passed (4 passed, 4 deselected) but the 'Upload LLM accuracy test results' step failed uploading llm_accuracy.xml/html artifact - blob storage endpoint returned an HTML error page instead of a JSON response

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_ubuntu_24
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check failed because the LLM accuracy iGPU tests job failed (exit 1), downstream of the artifact upload failure

key_errors: Beginning upload of artifact content to blob storage
##[error]<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"> <head> <meta charset="UTF-8"> ... (Actions artifact service returned a generic HTML error page instead of a JSON API response during blob upload)
root_cause: The pytest suite itself completed successfully (4 passed, 0 failed). The job failure originates entirely in the post-test 'Upload LLM accuracy test results' step, where actions/upload-artifact's call to the Actions artifact/blob storage service received an HTML error page instead of the expected API JSON response while 'Beginning upload of artifact content to blob storage'. This is characteristic of a transient outage, rate-limiting, or edge/proxy error on the GitHub Actions artifact backend (or an intermediate network proxy) unrelated to the PR's code changes (a single-line NPU mutex/exception-ordering fix in zero_mem_pool.cpp) or the test content being uploaded.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; requires hitting the GitHub Actions artifact/blob storage backend on the self-hosted iGPU runner at time of failure.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'LLM accuracy iGPU tests' job; the underlying tests already passed and this is very likely a transient artifact-service hiccup.
If the failure recurs, check GitHub Actions status page for artifact/blob storage service incidents around the failure timestamp (2026-09-04T09:45:59Z).

Consider adding retry/backoff wrapping around the upload-artifact step or setting continue-on-error for informational test-result artifacts so a transient upload issue does not fail the whole job when the actual test run passed.
No action needed on the PR itself (src/plugins/intel_npu/src/utils/src/zero/zero_mem_pool.cpp) - the failure is unrelated to the changed code.
prevention_strategies: Wrap non-critical result-artifact uploads (e.g., test result XML/HTML for reporting only) with retry logic or continue-on-error, since a failed upload of informational artifacts should not fail an otherwise-passing test job. Monitor for recurrence to distinguish a one-off blip from a systemic self-hosted runner networking issue.
historical_context: No prior CI Doctor MQ pattern exactly matches this signature (artifact upload receiving an HTML error page from blob storage). Related but distinct patterns exist for ECONNREFUSED/ENOTFOUND artifact upload/download failures on self-hosted Windows runners (patterns 1808e665f1f70825, 4e9cf236bf92d555, 669fb8e126e09420, b889d24cd154d2dd, c903843ea6da862b), all categorized Network/Infrastructure and generally resolved by re-running. This is the first occurrence of the HTML-error-page variant on the iGPU self-hosted runner.
